notes.title: Cards & Consequences
notes.notes:
Patch 0.83 introduces new features, visual upgrades, and key gameplay improvements based on community feedback. Here’s what’s new:

[h3]Video Overview with Starry Aerie[/h3]
[previewyoutube=MlwKQ0HSrRs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]🌟 New Gameplay Feature: Action Cards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Action Cards are now part of every match! At the start of each turn, you'll receive one Action Card to play instead of moving or building a ship.
[*] Cards offer unique strategic advantages, from defensive boosts to offensive plays.
[*] Each faction has a distinct set of cards, adding even more depth to your faction choice.
[/list]
[h3]⚡ New Mechanic: Chain Reaction[/h3]
[list]
[*] Capturing the enemy Flagship now triggers a Chain Reaction, instantly destroying their entire fleet.
[*] This removes the possibility of tie games and raises the stakes for protecting your Flagship.
[/list]
[h3]🎥 Improved Battle Camera[/h3]
[list]
[*] Camera angles during Battles have been enhanced to provide a more dynamic, angled view of the action—thanks to feedback from the Taipei Game Show.
[/list]
[h3]🔄 New Action Indicator[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new Action Indicator shows which actions each player has taken each turn, improving clarity and strategic planning.
[/list]
[h3]🎆 Visual & Audio Upgrades[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fragmentation now features new destruction animations for added impact.
[*] New sound effects have been added, including faction-specific thruster sounds.
[/list]
[h3]🐞 Bug Fixes & Polish[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.
[/list]
Thanks to everyone on Discord for the ongoing feedback and support!

- Your Starcade Arcade Team

notes.title: Thanks for a great start!
notes.notes:

Thank you all for adding our game to your library, downloading and trying it over the past few weeks. We want to give a special shoutout and thanks for those who went the extra mile to leave us a Positive review as well. That really helps boost our game and get more users in to play!

We will be releasing our next update next week. It includes all of the bug fixes that we got input from over Discord, Steam, and Taipei Game Show. The gameplay is now going to be more polished than ever. There's some neat little features tucked in as well! One more time, we would like to say thank you for everyone who provided that input. We take it seriously and next week you're going to see proof of that!

notes.title: Early Access Release Coming January 9th
notes.notes:
[h2]Early Access Release Jan 9th[/h2]
After 2 years of development, we are releasing [i]Starcade FACTIONS[/i] as Early Access on January 9th. We've taken the game through a Playtest, launched the Demo at Steam NEXT Fest, debuted at GSTAR Korea, and now we're ready to take it to the next phase with a wider audience by releasing in Early Access.

[h2]Taipei Game Show[/h2]
[i]Starcade FACTIONS[/i] will be shown live at Taipei Game Show. Since Starcade Arcade has a strong history with Taiwan's gaming scene through our partnership with HTC on the VR game Space Slurpies, we decided that Taipei Game Show was the perfect timing to release the  game as Early Access.

[h2]Early Access Replaces Demo[/h2]
[i]Starcade FACTIONS[/i] is and will always be a Free-to-Play game, so we are removing the Demo from the store. Interested users should just download the full game and enjoy the experience. All updated content will be apart of the Early Access release.

[h2]Launch Day Content[/h2]
The game is already packed with lots of content to get started, including:
[list]
[*] Single player Tutorial and Gameplay
[*] Online PVP Matchmaking
[*] Private games with Friends
[*] 3 Unique Factions to play
[*] 30 different ships: 10 for each of the 3 Factions
[*] Multiple maps with unique modifiers
[/list]
[h3]Wishlist or Download today![/h3]

[h2]Welcome to [i]Starcade FACTIONS![/i][/h2]

notes.title: Solo Dev plays new space CCG / Strategy game!
notes.notes:
Join the live stream of the solo developer behind four VR titles as I unveil my latest creation: Starcade FACTIONS, a mobile and PC space strategy game! After two years of development since pivoting from VR, I'm excited to showcase it at Steam NEXT Fest.

Starcade FACTIONS is a turn-based strategy game where space commanders battle ships in short, action-packed games that last about 5 minutes. With 10 different types of ships, including Fighters, Medics, and Builders, the game offers layers of strategy while keeping basic actions simple to learn. Each turn, you can move your ships, target enemies, or capture the opposing Flagship to win the game.

Tune in for an exciting session where I'll discuss the game, its strategies, and the journey of creating a multiplayer mobile game as a solo dev. Don't miss it!
